title: GreenGateway Deployment Configuration
description: The deployment document of a greengateway.dev/v1alpha1 configuration bundle. In this alpha the specification carries only the deployment profile: the deployment settings are added from the configuration field catalog (issue #242) before a gateway can start from a bundle, and until then any other member is refused rather than ignored. The $defs fix the typed value forms those settings will use: a sensitive setting accepts only a secretReference, a fractional setting only a decimal string, and no setting accepts an unresolved placeholder. This schema is necessary but not sufficient: the gateway's reader is authoritative.

apiVersion.description: Exact document version. No other version, prefix, or spelling is accepted.

profile.description: The deployment profile. Its invariants are enforced by the configuration compiler, not by this schema.

secretReference.description: An opaque secret alias ID resolved by the gateway's secret providers. It is never a secret value, an environment-variable name, a file path, a provider locator, or ciphertext.

unresolved.description: A placeholder an export, conversion, or template writes where it could not or would not supply a value. No setting accepts one, so a document that contains one never validates.

decimal.description: A fractional setting written as a string; JSON numbers in bundle documents are integers only. The canonical form is the shortest exact spelling.
